increment: Angular Wave 2 - Publication Preflight (read-only, no publish)
scope: read-only prepublication assessment; no production change; no registry action

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Built npm package contains all required runtime and declaration files
acceptanceCriteria.finding: Packed tarball root package.json has no main/module/types/exports. The generated dist/package.json (which has them) is excluded by dist/.npmignore (**/package.json). FESM + .d.ts are physically present but unreachable without entry points.

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Export paths resolve from the packed distribution
acceptanceCriteria.finding: Clean install of packed tarball -> require.resolve('@smilodon/angular') = MODULE_NOT_FOUND. The AOT consumer test masks this by symlinking tests/consumer/node_modules/@smilodon/angular -> dist, bypassing real package resolution.

evidence.cleanInstall: npm install ./smilodon-angular-1.13.0.tgz into empty temp project

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Angular peer and Node.js engine ranges accurately represent supported configurations
acceptanceCriteria.finding: Angular peer >=21.0.0 <22.0.0 is correct, but engines.node = '>=18' advertises unsupported Node. Angular 21 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.12.0 || ^24.0.0.
Registry has @smilodon/core@1.22.0; local v1.21.0. Peer ^1.13.0 satisfies both 1.21.0 and 1.22.0 (semver.satisfies = true).

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: smilodon-angular-select documented as the public selector
acceptanceCriteria.finding: Component selector is 'smilodon-angular-select' (select.component.ts:112); documented in README usage (lines 31-39, 149-156).

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: L-01, L-02, and L-03 limitations visible to consumers
acceptanceCriteria.finding: L-02 (async provenance) documented in README (168-184, 'Disclosed limitation'). L-01 (WebKit unverified) and L-03 (initial empty multi-select change) are absent from the consumer README.

L-01.topic: WebKit not verified on release build host

L-03.topic: initial empty change on multi-select init

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Release version and registry destination explicitly identified
acceptanceCriteria.finding: @smilodon/angular@1.13.0, publishConfig.registry = https://registry.npmjs.org/, access: public. @smilodon/angular returns 404 on the registry (first public release). Version 1.13.0 is out-of-step with the family (core 1.22.0, siblings 1.12.0) - confirm intended version at release decision.

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Final GO/NO-GO record produced without publishing
acceptanceCriteria.finding: This record. NO-GO. No registry action taken.

rootCauseP0_01_P0_02.summary: ng-packagr emits a complete manifest at dist/package.json (module, typings, exports) and code under dist/. Source package.json declares only files:['dist','README.md'] with no entry-point fields. On publish from package root, npm includes the source package.json (no entry points) and excludes dist/package.json via dist/.npmignore (**/package.json). Result: published manifest has no main/module/types/exports; present FESM/d.ts are unreachable.
rootCauseP0_01_P0_02.siblingConvention: Every other @smilodon/* package declares entry points in the source package.json pointing into ./dist/... and does not rely on a nested dist/package.json.
rootCauseP0_01_P0_02.outlier: angular is the sole package without source entry points and with a nested dist/package.json.
rootCauseP0_01_P0_02.consumerTestMaskingFactor: tests/consumer/run-consumer.mjs symlinks tests/consumer/node_modules/@smilodon/angular -> dist, importing dist/package.json directly, so it never exercises real package resolution.

remediationOptions.action: Add main/module/typings/types/exports to source packages/angular/package.json pointing into ./dist/...; update consumer test to resolve via a real packed install; add packed-install smoke gate to CI.
Set publishConfig.directory = 'dist' and publish via npm publish -w @smilodon/angular; adjust files to avoid double-nesting dist/.

remediationDeferred.note: All fixes are production metadata/doc edits and are deferred to a separate, explicitly-authorized correction increment. S5-P0 is read-only and made no production change.
items: P0-01/P0-02: package.json entry points + CI packed-install gate
P0-06: add L-01 and L-03 (and keep L-02) to consumer README 'Known limitations'

preservedLimitations.L-02: Async provenance accepted known limitation; edits during pending fetches may be suppressed
preservedLimitations.L-03: Multi-select initial empty change, documented behavior
preservedLimitations.L-04: Core tsc 44 pre-existing, S6 NO-GO scope

recommendation: NO-GO for publication. Resolve P0-01/P0-02 (packaging entry points), P0-03 (engine range = P01), and P0-06 (L-01/L-03 disclosure) in a separate bounded authorized correction increment, then re-run S5-P0 preflight. Publication remains a distinct, explicitly-gated decision.
